notes: parallel-agents provides multi-agent orchestration patterns: spawn independent specialist streams via multiple Agent tool calls in a SINGLE message, sequence dependent streams instead, then synthesize all outputs into one consolidated report. Frontmatter has user-invocable:false, so it is model-invoked only. Evaluate whether independent work is parallelized (one message, multiple Agent calls), dependent work is sequenced, and a single synthesis report is produced.

evals.prompt: We need the backend NestJS module, the frontend Vue views, and the unit tests written — they're independent, do them at the same time.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes independent streams and spawns developer-agent (backend), developer-agent (frontend), and unit-test-agent concurrently as multiple Agent tool calls in a single message, then merges the results into one Orchestration Synthesis report rather than separate disconnected outputs.

evals.prompt: Run a comprehensive review of the whole codebase — security, performance, and quality perspectives, all in parallel.
evals.expected_output: Spawns the review streams (e.g. code-review-agent per area + security-tester-agent) concurrently in one message, then synthesizes a single consolidated findings report with a unified Action Items list.

evals.prompt: Fix the typo in the README heading.
evals.expected_output: A single trivial single-domain edit — no multi-agent orchestration is warranted. Should NOT trigger parallel spawning; handle directly with no Agent tool calls (matches the 'Not for: simple, single-domain tasks / quick fixes' guidance).
